prompt: Create an original transparent-background sprite of ONE fictional banknote for the premium Brazilian tropical board game Império Urbano. Asset must be immediately readable when flying across a game UI at only 30 pixels wide. Horizontal rectangular single bill about 2:1 aspect ratio, nearly straight-on front view with very subtle paper curvature, whole silhouette visible, small transparent margins. Rich emerald green and deep teal engraved paper, warm ivory inset, fine restrained champagne-gold edging, one simple stylized golden urban skyline medallion in the center and a few broad flowing wave / tropical-leaf engraved motifs. Bold clean contours, high contrast, polished hand-painted 3D cartoon rendering matching a colorful illustrated Brazilian property board game. Make it feel like beautiful game currency, not a realistic official banknote. One bill only: no stack, no money bundle, no coins, no hands, no straps, no scattering confetti. No numbers, no printed denomination, no letters, no readable text, no real bank logo, no official Brazilian banknote portrait or seal, no flag, no watermark. The neutral denomination is essential because the same sprite will represent any payment amount. No large outside shadow. Actual alpha transparency around the paper; entire banknote stays opaque. Suitable as a lightweight crisp 2D flight animation sprite.
